I mean, talk about issues like supply chain and energy, getting oil and gas to the refineries. I mean, all of that. It's going to take a little while for that to get done because of the rules set forth for the House in terms of elected and speaker. But lots of ships are going to have, you know, divided government for sure. The Senate looks like it'll be 51-49 in favor of the Democrats once the Georgia election is done in early December. So a lot of new faces coming on board, committee staffs, all of that. And of course, We'll have the election of our lifetime coming in 2024 with who knows who is running and who will ultimately win and a real change over perhaps then too. So it's going to be an exciting finish for me as I look to finish 36 years in the house and getting things done based on the real Ronald Reagan model where I worked back in the 80s of trying to govern. And that he did it well, worked with the Democratic Congress. And that's always been my philosophy, my tenure in the House.
